source.game_identity: explicit source selection; not independently encoded/attested by schema format

catalogue.verification: index content and every class reference SHA-256 verified; enums outside help audit scope

coverage_policy: Element exact class keys; declared fields use their declaring owner. Inherited occurrences keep contextual target and declaring owner separate, with union counts explicitly labeled. Labels/name_ref do not count as descriptive help; no aliases.

game_version.binding: user-supplied version metadata; no cryptographic binding to the help, VPK or schema snapshot
game_version.name: steam.inf

archive.hashScope: header and directory tree; excludes payload and checksum/signature sections

manifest.archive_verification: manifest metadata only; archive/tree/signature not revalidated by this helper
manifest.name: vpk-reference-manifest.json

public_mirror_reference.status: reference URL only; not fetched or asserted equal to local bytes

warnings: Local editor help is descriptive documentation, not evidence of compilation, retained KV3 properties, runtime behavior or rendering parity.
Reflection fields may be nonserialized (for example MNotSaved); a reflected field plus help does not establish KV3 editability.
Keys are case-sensitive exact matches. Historical names, UI labels and name_ref texts are never aliases or redirects.
The schema snapshot may be newer than the installed game. Compatibility and the chronological relationship are unknown unless separately established.
HTML and links remain inert source text; this helper neither renders HTML nor follows links.

verification_context.run_annotation: Date and historical report identity attached after the standard helper audit; coverage data and provenance are its unmodified fresh output.
